log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 = quiet, 1 = normal, 2 = verbose, 3 = debug.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of recent lease entries to show in the HTML status page.

html_status.description: Enable or disable generation of the HTML status page.

html_output.description: File path where the HTML status page will be written.

json_output.description: File path where the JSON status page will be written (if enabled).

json_status.description: Enable or disable generation of the JSON status page.

csv_output.description: File path for the CSV summary output; empty disables CSV output.

csv_status.description: Enable or disable generation of the CSV summary.

tz_offset.description: Time zone offset in ±HHMM format (e.g., '+0800' for UTC+8).

hostname.description: Hostname or FQDN to use in status page URLs. Leave empty to auto-detect.

listen_iface.description: Network interface to bind the status HTTP server to. Empty disables HTTP server.

listen_port.description: HTTP port for the status server. Only used if listen_iface is set.

update_interval.description: Seconds between automatic status page updates.

snmp_enable.description: Enable or disable SNMP polling for additional metrics.

snmp_community.description: SNMP community string to use for polling (if enabled).

subnets.description: List of subnets and DHCP pools to monitor.

netmask.description: Netmask (optional; if empty, inferred from network's CIDR).

start.description: First IP in the DHCP pool range (e.g., '192.168.1.100').

end.description: Last IP in the DHCP pool range (e.g., '192.168.1.200').

lease_time.description: Default DHCP lease duration in seconds.

enabled.description: Enable or disable monitoring of this subnet.

comment.description: Optional human-readable description of this subnet.
